title: Shyp: tap an app, a courier picks up, packs and ships

source.text: Shyp: tap an app and a courier picks up, packs and ships any item for $5 plus postage, launch country US. Score it as of 2014-03-01: use only evidence published on or before that date (set verdict.as_of). Founder: a seed-funded startup. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug shyp.

problem: Shipping an item means finding a box, packing it, printing a label and queuing at a post office or carrier store.
customer: San Francisco smartphone owners (25-34 professionals) and small online sellers shipping a few parcels a month
solution: iPhone app: a courier picks up any item at your door, Shyp packs it and ships it with the best carrier rate.
claims: a courier picks up, packs and ships any item for $5 plus postage
assumptions: Launch city is San Francisco, where the private beta runs
Average postage about USD 12 per shipment
Couriers are per-pickup contractors, as reported in 2013
